calibration_note: Maps the model output to the share of past cases that reached target 1 before the stop (walk-forward predictions 2023-01-01 to 2025-10-01).

gate.label: the 4h model leans the same way

policy_note: A symbol gets a signal when the 1h model's score is at least the threshold chosen on the validation years AND the 4h model leans the same way (multi-timeframe alignment). One trade at a time per symbol, a cooldown of 2 candles, at most 8 new signals per candle.

limit_test.question: more than 4 new signals in the same hour?
limit_test.rule: the highest limit whose walk-forward result passes rule v2 is chosen on the validation years; it goes live only if the year the model never saw reaches >= 70% wins, a positive average after costs and >= 50 signals
